scope: Read-only review of sprite walking cadence/hold, guest snapshots, touch routing, gesture cancellation, PC and local2P compatibility, and the corrective tests.

initialFindings.issue: Guest snapshots omit tx/ty and may mark moving false while short arrival movement remains, which could repeatedly terminate the walking hold.
initialFindings.resolution: World passes undefined intent when guest goal coordinates are absent; an actual SnapshotEncoder/JSON/applySnapshot/120Hz world regression covers the final movement.

initialFindings.issue: A construction-choice button could bypass the suppression of trailing multi-touch clicks and spend gold.
initialFindings.resolution: The build command guard also respects suppression; a real-session regression verifies no tower or wallet mutation.

finalReviewerConclusion: 두 잔여 오류의 수정과 회귀 검사를 확인했습니다. 이번 변경 범위에서 추가 수정이 필요한 구체적 버그는 발견하지 못했습니다.
